review_method: All 22 rows and six new/used cells visually checked against the complete Pirelli Motorsport race-set graphic reproduced by Coffee Corner Motorsport on 8 November, then matched to the official 22-car Starting Grid. The article confirms one new Hard and Medium per driver, four new Softs for the ten Q3 drivers and five for the rest; Pirelli confirms qualifying used only wet-weather tyres. Dashes mean zero remaining used slicks. Counts ordered soft new/used, medium new/used, hard new/used.
